summary: Makati City 1st District representative with 89 principal-authored bills. Authored an estate tax amnesty extension to 2030 and a broadcast franchise renewal; co-authored anti-dynasty bills. One issue per dimension. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
